conclusion: A model-specific operator closure is the right scope-control artifact for Qwen3.5-0.8B, but source discovery and shape checks are not AMD execution results.
decision: Use the 15 text-only contracts as the required execution matrix, exclude full ROCm/OpenCL CTS from the critical path, and keep each contract failed until it executes through GemSim with a differential oracle and zero CPU/NVIDIA fallback.
invalidated_assumptions: The full ROCm or OpenCL CTS must pass before model-specific progress is useful.
Static Triton symbol discovery or execution on an NVIDIA device can count as AMD simulator coverage.
observation: The source-grounded manifest finds 15 text-only contracts across 18 GDN and 6 full-attention layers, while the strict runtime smoke remains blocked because the current PyTorch environment has CUDA but no HIP device path.
question_or_symptom: How can the project narrow validation to the operators the target model actually uses without weakening the no-fallback requirement?
